name: Pipeliners - SEO Check All Pages 2026-10-15
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-10-15

# Summary
An on-page SEO scorecard of 100 live URLs (52 pages, 48 posts) run Oct 15, 2026 and re-run Oct 16 after fixes. Each row has a score, an issue list, a house-style check, title and meta lengths, H1 and H2 counts, heading skips, images without alt, schema types, internal links, weak anchors, canonical, robots and og:title.

# Key findings
- Average score 95.4 before and 97.1 after.
- Most common issues before: skipped heading levels (42 pages), posts with no Article schema (31), missing og/twitter tags (4 to 5), short titles (4), missing metas (3, mostly noindex utility pages).
- House-style flags: "Pipeliners USA" on 25 URLs and "pipe lining/pipelining" on 10.
- Lowest scores were noindex utility pages (/thank-you/ 61, /sales-cost-estimator/ 69) and /contact/ (77).
- After the Oct 16 pass: Article schema added to the posts that lacked it (31 posts per the change log) and og/twitter tags fixed on /contact/, /should-i-diy-pipe-repair/, /trenchless-drain-pipe-repair/ and /fort-mcdowell/. 13 posts reached 100. Heading-skip issues remained.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `seo_check_all_pages.csv` (Oct 15) and `seo_check_all_pages_after_2026-10-16.csv`.
